audited_by: Claude (AI assistant), 2026-10-27, from extracted PDF text; not yet reviewed by a person
method: Quotes are admitted only if found in the cited transcript page (exact or reversible normalisation, no fuzzy matching), inside a turn of the cited speaker whose role comes from the same document. Outcomes are computed only for metrics the snapshot holds on the matching basis. No LLM is used.

known_misses.why: 'We want to exit at 25% plus...' has a number and a forward word but no topic keyword ('margin' is in the question, not the answer), so the filter dropped it. Found by reading the Q&A around the margin question.
'...target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.' has no topic keyword for exports. Found while checking later mentions of the export target.
'We expect this to normalize to our long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days...' says 'this' for the working-capital cycle, so no topic keyword matched. Found while tracing the 45-50 days range back.
'The loan deposit ratio is not a constraint.' has no forward word. Found while checking later mentions of the LDR range.
'...towards our stated objective of exceeding 30% by FY 2030.' (dividend payout) has no topic keyword for dividends. Found in the final review while checking omitted commitments.
